blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity single-shot synthesis, yet practical storytelling creation requires multi-shot videos with both strong inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. Existing multi-shot video generation approaches achieve strong consistency but still fall short in controllability. In this paper, we propose Mise-en-Video (MeV), a highly controllable multi-shot video generation framework that allows video creators to conduct staging the multi-shot in the 3D space and then generate the corresponding multi-shot video. To achieve this, our framework combines a hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-level narrative consistency with 3D-aware layout guidance for precise, per-shot spatial control. To support training and evaluation, we develop standardized annotation pipelines and construct a 160K-video dataset with hierarchical multi-shot texts and oriented 3D bounding boxes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeV consistently outperforms strong baselines in video quality, inter-shot consistency, and subject-level controllability.
blocks.zh: 最近从文本到视频生成的进步使得能进行高真实度的单发合成,然而实用的故事创作需要多发视频,既具有强烈的相接一致性,也具有精细的可控性. 现有的多镜头视频生成方法具有很强的一致性,但控制能力仍然不足。 在本文中,我们提出Mise-en-Video(MeV),这是一个高度可控多镜头视频生成框架,它允许视频创作者在3D空间进行多镜头的中传,然后生成相应的多镜头视频. 为了实现这一点,我们的框架将多层次叙事一致性的分级关注机制与3D-意识布局指导相结合,用于精确,每发空间控制. 为了支持培训和评价,我们开发了标准化的注解管道,并建造了一个160K-视频数据集,其中包含分级多镜头文本和取向的3D边框. 广泛的实验表明,MeV在视频质量、相机相通性和主题层面可控性方面一贯超过强基线。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : We propose MeV to help creators generate high-quality multi-shot video content. For each shot, creators specify a 3D layout, akin to staging a real 3D set (first column), and define actors’ appearance, trajectories, positions, and other 3D scene parameters. We render the 3D layout as a control signal (shown in the insets) and feed it into the generator, enabling stronger cross-shot consistency and finer-grained controllability.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们提议MeV帮助创作者制作高质量的多镜头视频内容. 对于每个镜头,创建者指定一个3D布局,类似于一个真正的3D集(第一列),并定义演员的外观,轨迹,位置,以及其他3D场景参数. 我们把3D布局做成一个控制信号(在套件中抛开),并输入生成器,从而增强交叉射击的一致性和精细的可控性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
With the continuous iteration and maturity of text-to-video generation technology [ 36 , 21 , 35 ] , it has been widely applied in artistic creation, film production, and other fields, and has become an important technical support in the field of content production.
However, the current mainstream video generation models still have obvious limitations. Although they perform well in synthesizing high-fidelity single-shot videos, they find it difficult to meet the more complex content needs in practical applications.
In narrative scenarios such as film and television, the presentation of long-form stories often relies on the organic combination of multiple shots [ 12 ] , which is still a challenging and open problem for current video generation models.
Especially the difficulty in simultaneously ensuring inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability, which has become a key bottleneck restricting the practical application of T2V technology.
blocks.zh:
随着文本到视频生成技术的连续迭代和成熟[36,21,35],它被广泛应用于艺术创作,电影制作等领域,成为内容制作领域的重要技术支持.
然而,目前的主流视频生成模型仍然有明显的局限性. 虽然它们在合成高真实度单拍视频方面表现良好,但发现在实际应用中难以满足更复杂的内容需求.
在电影和电视等叙事情景中,长形故事的呈现往往依赖于多镜头的有机组合[12],这对于目前的视频生成模型来说仍然是一个挑战性和开放性的问题.
特别是难以同时确保枪口间的一致性和精细的可控性,这已成为限制T2V技术实际应用的关键瓶颈.

blocks.en:
Multi-shot video generation puts higher requirements on generation models in two aspects: consistency and controllability. First, to achieve coherent narrative expression, the generated multi-shot videos must maintain consistency in the background environment, core theme, and characters across shots.
Second, beyond mere narrative stability, professional content creation requires granular steerability over the generative process. As creators seek to move past randomized outputs, the focus has shifted toward precisely manipulating key cinematic elements, such as shot composition, subject positions, and camera angles, making controllable multi-shot generation a pivotal frontier in the field.
blocks.zh:
多镜头视频生成在两个方面对生成模型提出了更高的要求:一致性和可控性. 首先,为了实现连贯的叙事表达,生成的多镜头视频必须保持背景环境,核心主题和人物跨镜头的一致性.
第二,除了叙述稳定性之外,专业内容的创造需要颗粒性可支配基因过程。 随着创作者试图移动过随机化产出,重点已经转向精确地操纵关键的电影元素,如镜头组成,主题位置,以及镜头角度,使得可控多镜头一代成为该领域的关键前沿.

blocks.en: Existing multi-shot video generation methods generally follow two paradigms: decoupled generation and one-time generation. Earlier decoupled approaches [ 45 , 54 ] generate shots independently and splice them together; while this allows for individual shot control, it often fails to maintain inter-shot consistency in identity and style. Conversely, one-time generation methods [ 29 , 43 , 18 , 3 ] leverage cross-shot attention to ensure global coherence, yet they often trade off fine-grained controllability. Most such models solely rely on text prompts for each shot to guide shot generation, which we observe to be insufficient for complex creation.
blocks.zh: 现有的多镜头视频生成方法一般遵循两个模式:脱钩生成和一次性生成. 较早的脱钩方法[45,54]独立地产生枪声,并连结在一起;虽然这允许个人枪声控制,但往往无法保持枪声间在身份和风格上的一致性. 反之,一次性生成方法[29、43、18、3]利用交叉的注意力来确保全球的一致性,但它们往往以精细的可控性为交换条件。 大多数这样的模型只依靠每个镜头的文字提示来引导镜头生成,我们观察到这不足以进行复杂的生成.

blocks.en:
Specifically, our key observation is that such a text attention mechanism ignores the fact that the videos are projections of 3D scenes and video creators (directors) usually first conduct 3D staging to determine the subject layout and then fill in the details for each subject.
In contrast, current multi-shot generation methods directly input all the textual details of each shot and leave the video generation model to determine the subject layout.
This causes the following two issues.
1. Confusion of spatial relationships: Text descriptions are often underspecified or ambiguous regarding 3D geometry, and without explicit 3D modeling, the generated shots may exhibit inconsistent depth ordering and unreasonable spatial layouts.
2. Inability to control dynamic movements: Text prompts naturally lack the spatial awareness, making them hard to specify subject motions such as movement trajectories and turning directions. However, to ensure the correct narrative, video creators have a strong need to specify the movement and actions of actors.
blocks.zh:
具体来说,我们的关键观察是,这样的文本关注机制忽略了这样的事实,即视频是3D场景的投影,视频创作者(导演)通常首先进行3D中程以确定主题布局,然后填写每个主题的细节.
相比之下,目前的多镜头生成方法直接输入每个镜头的所有文字细节,并离开视频生成模型来确定主题布局.
这引起了以下两个问题。
一、导 言 空间关系的混乱: 文字描述在3D几何学上往往不够精确或模糊,没有明确的3D模型,生成的镜头可能表现出不一致的深度顺序和不合理的空间布局.
2. 无法控制动态流动: 文本提示自然缺乏空间意识,使其难以指定运动轨迹和转动方向等主题运动. 然而,为了确保正确的叙事,视频创作者非常需要具体描述演员的动作和行动.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Mise-en-Video ( MeV ), a novel and highly controllable multi-shot video generation framework, which effectively assists artists in creating high-quality multi-shot videos. Within MeV, creators can specify the 3D layout of each shot, like setting up a real 3D stage, and define the movement of actors, the position of objects, and other 3D-related parameters. Directly staging the plot in the 3D space not only ensures the correctness of 3D spatial relationships but also enables precisely specifying the dynamics of subjects in the 3D space.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出Mise-en-Video(MeV),这是一个小说和高度可控的多镜头视频生成框架,有效地协助艺术家制作高质量的多镜头视频. 在MeV内部,创造者可以指定每个镜头的3D布局,比如设置一个真正的3D阶段,并定义演员的移动,对象的位置,以及其他3D相关的参数. 在3D空间直接布局地块,不仅能确保3D空间关系的正确性,而且能精确地说明3D空间中主体的动态.

blocks.en:
Designing such a 3D-aware multi-shot video generation method is non-trivial.
Such a framework requires taking both the text prompts and 3D layout as conditions into a 2D video generation, which suffers from severe modality mismatch.
First, the 3D layout designed by the creators needs to be converted into effective 2D control signals for video generation.
However, fine-grained 3D geometry information, such as point clouds or depth maps, is not only hard to obtain but also lacks flexibility in practical creation.
Meanwhile, simply adopting coarse 3D bounding boxes cannot accurately control the detailed behaviors of subjects, such as character turning and posture adjustment.
Therefore, it is still a challenge to design a flexible but steerable 2D control from the 3D layout.
Second, how to effectively associate the subject textual descriptions with the specific 3D subject still remains unexplored. A multi-shot video generation usually involves multiple subjects. Simply associating each video shot with the shot description without subject-level association often leads to confusion about the subject.
blocks.zh:
设计这种3D-意识多镜头视频生成方法是非三角的.
这种框架要求将文字提示和3D布局作为条件,形成2D视频生成,而2D视频生成方式严重不匹配。
首先,创作者设计的3D布局需要转换成有效的2D控制信号,用于视频生成.
然而,精细的3D几何信息,如点云或深度地图,不仅难以获得,而且在实际创作中也缺乏灵活性.
同时,仅仅采用粗细的3D边框无法准确控制对象的详细行为,如人物转动和姿态调整.
因此,从3D布局设计一个灵活但可引导的2D控制仍然是一项挑战.
第二,如何有效地将主题文字描述与具体的3D主题联系起来,仍然没有得到探讨。 多镜头视频生成通常涉及多个主题. 仅仅将每个视频镜头与镜头描述联系起来,而没有主题层面的关联,往往导致对主题的混淆.

blocks.en:
To address the above challenges, we adopt two key designs.
First, we design a Subject Layout Guidance to convert 3D layouts into 2D control signals.
Considering the trade-off between control flexibility and representational complexity, we represent each subject using oriented 3D bounding boxes. This representation is intentionally lightweight, allowing creators to intuitively define the 3D layout and blocking of a scene without the need for exhaustive geometric modeling.
To bridge the gap between coarse boxes and fine-grained subject dynamics, we propose a NOCS [ 37 ] -based (Normalized Object Coordinate Space) color encoding scheme. By mapping canonical coordinates onto the 3D boxes, we transform abstract orientations and movements, such as a character turning or tilting, into dense, orientation-aware visual cues.
These 3D representations are projected into the 2D camera view to form per-frame layout maps. To resolve the modality mismatch between 3D-structured signals and 2D pixel generation, we employ a ControlNet-like structure to inject these signals into the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone.
blocks.zh:
为了应对上述挑战,我们采取了两项关键设计。
首先,我们设计了一个主题布局指导,将3D布局转换为2D控制信号.
考虑到控制灵活性和代表性复杂性之间的权衡,我们使用面向的3D边框代表每个主题。 这种表示方式是故意轻量级的,允许创作者直观地定义3D布局,并屏蔽一个场景,而不需要详尽的几何模型.
为了弥合粗箱和细纹主题动力学之间的差距,我们提出了一个基于NOCS [37] - (Normalized Object Coord Space) 色彩编码方案. 通过将舟形坐标映射到3D盒上,我们把抽象的方向和运动,例如人物转动或倾斜,转变为密集的,定向的视觉提示.
这些3D表示被投射到2D相机视图中,形成每帧布局图. 为了解决3D结构信号和2D像素生成之间的模式不匹配问题,我们采用了类似ControlNet的结构,将这些信号注入分散变压器(DIT)主干线.

blocks.en:
Then, to effectively associate the subject texts with the subject bounding box, we adopt the Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism.
To ensure the fluency of multi-shot narrative and the rationality of subject interaction, we divide the text description into three levels: global level, shot level, and subject level.
Then, we modify the attention weights to restrict different levels of descriptions to different levels of video content. Global texts will be visible to all tokens, shot-level texts will be visible only to the specific shot, and the subject-level texts are restricted to the subject token regions.
The Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism can efficiently capture and fuse information from these three levels, improving the model’s adherence to global narrative intent, shot-specific requirements, and subject-level attributes, thereby enhancing both controllability and cross-shot consistency.
blocks.zh:
然后,为了有效地将主题文本与主题约束框联系起来,我们采用了等级背景关注机制。
为确保多镜头叙事的流畅性和主题互动的合理性,我们将文字描述分为三个层面:全球层面,镜头层面,以及主题层面.
之后,我们修改了关注权重,将不同级别的描述限制在不同的视频内容级别. 全局文本会在所有符号中可见,镜头级文本只可见特定镜头,主题级文本仅限于主题符号区域.
分级背景关注机制可以高效地捕捉和引信这三级的信息,改善模型对全局叙事意图的坚持,镜头特定要求,以及主题层次属性,从而增强可控性和交叉镜头一致性.

blocks.en: By coupling Hierarchical Context Attention with Subject Layout Guidance, our model effectively utilizes 3D signals to control the multi-shot video generation. To train our model, we construct a 160K video dataset, which includes multi-shot hierarchical text descriptions, NOCS color maps, and 3D bounding boxes with orientation information. This dataset provides solid data support for model training and evaluation, improving the robustness and generalization of the framework.
blocks.zh: 通过将分级背景关注与主题布局指导相结合,我们的模型有效地利用了3D信号来控制多镜头视频生成. 为了训练我们的模型,我们构建了一个160K视频数据集,其中包括多镜头的分层文字描述,NOCS颜色图,以及带有定向信息的3D边框. 该数据集为模型培训和评价提供了坚实的数据支持,提高了框架的稳健性和概括性.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Results show that MeV consistently outperforms baselines in video quality, inter-shot consistency, and subject-level controllability.
In particular, MeV achieves improved performance on both general video quality metrics and specialized controllability metrics, demonstrating the ability to support fine-grain control for multi-shot video creation.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验验证了拟议框架的有效性。 结果显示,MeV在视频质量、镜头间一致性和主题层面的可控性方面,持续超过基线。
特别是,MeV在一般视频质量度量和专用可控性度量上都实现了更好的性能,证明了支持多镜头视频创作的精度控制的能力.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of MeV. Creators first design the 3D scene and provide a hierarchical caption. We project the 3D layout into an NOCS-based encoding scheme and use it as guidance for ControlDiT. Meanwhile, we decompose the caption into global-, shot-, and subject-level descriptions, and fuse them via a Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism to enhance narrative consistency and subject coherence across shots.
blocks.zh: 图2 : MeV. 创建者首先设计了3D场景,并提供了分级标题. 我们把3D布局投射到一个基于NOCS的编码方案,并将其作为ControlDIT的指南. 同时,我们把标题分解成全局、镜头和主题层面的描述,并通过一个分级背景关注机制来整合这些描述,以加强叙事一致性和各个镜头的主题一致性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Single-Shot Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 单热视频生成

blocks.en: The advent of Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ 32 ] architectures has brought substantial improvements to the video generation in visual quality, duration, and text prompt following [ 2 , 8 , 55 ] . The widely-used HunyuanVideo [ 21 ] and Wan [ 36 ] are constructed by significantly scaling up model capacity and training data, paving the way for the community to delve into fresh frontiers of world modeling and its diverse applications. To further push the boundary of single-shot video length, several works have explored autoregressive and streaming generation paradigms. FramePack [ 49 ] proposes a structured frame packing strategy that compresses historical context into compact representations, allowing the model to generate videos of arbitrary length in a sliding-window fashion while maintaining temporal consistency. Self-Forcing [ 16 ] addresses the training-inference discrepancy in autoregressive video generation by training the model to condition on its own previously generated frames, enabling stable long-video synthesis without exposure bias. Despite these advances in generating longer and more temporally coherent single-shot videos [ 15 , 46 ] , they remain fundamentally constrained to a single continuous camera shot. Such single-shot video generation lacks narrative expressiveness and is unable to convey rich information through varied shots as films do, making it difficult to captivate audiences for extended viewing.
blocks.zh: 传播变形器(DiT)[32]架构的出现,在视觉质量,持续时间和文本提示方面对视频生成带来了实质性的改进,紧接着[2,8,55]. 广泛使用的HunyuanVideo[21]和Wan[36]是通过大幅扩大模型容量和培训数据来构建的,为社区探索世界模型及其各种应用的新领域铺平了道路。 为了进一步推进单镜头视频长度的界限,多部作品探索了自旋式和流传式的生成模式. FramePack [49] 提出了结构化的框架包装策略,将历史背景压缩为紧凑的表示,使模型能够以滑动窗口的方式产生任意长度的视频,同时保持时间一致性. 自强制 [16] 解决自递录视频生成中的培训-推论差异问题,培训该模型以自身先前生成的帧为条件,使得稳定的长视频合成没有曝光偏差. 尽管在制作时间更长和更加一致的单镜头视频[15,46]方面取得了这些进展,但它们仍然从根本上受到单个连续镜头拍摄的限制. 这种单拍视频生成缺乏叙事表达力,无法像电影那样通过各种镜头传递丰富的信息,因此难以吸引观众进行扩展观看.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-Shot Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 多热视频生成

blocks.en: With the rapid advancement of single-shot video generation methods [ 36 , 35 ] , these models have been widely adopted in commercial scenarios such as advertisement production and media content creation. Consequently, the research focus is shifting from single-shot to multi-shot video generation [ 12 , 18 , 3 , 29 , 43 , 38 , 28 , 40 ] . This emerging paradigm aims to generate videos composed of multiple shots while maintaining subject and scene consistency across varying camera perspectives, thereby facilitating complex narrative storytelling. Existing multi-shot video generation methods generally fall into two categories. The first category [ 54 , 45 ] employs a two-stage approach: it initially generates the starting frame of each shot and subsequently uses an image-to-video method to extend them. However, this approach yields suboptimal results, as consistency is only guaranteed across the initial frames. The second category [ 29 , 43 , 40 , 18 , 3 ] leverages contextual learning to model the relationships between shots, ensuring better global consistency. Although effective, these models [ 29 , 18 , 3 , 43 ] suffer from limited controllability, as they can only guide the generated content through text prompts, making it difficult for users to achieve their precise desired outcomes.
blocks.zh: 随着单镜头视频生成方法的迅速发展[36,35],这些模型在广告制作和媒体内容创作等商业情景中被广泛采用. 因此,研究重点正在从单拍转向多拍视频生成[12、18、3、29、43、38、28、40]。 这个新兴的范式旨在生成由多个镜头组成的视频,同时保持不同镜头视角的主题和场景一致性,从而便利复杂的叙事故事讲述. 现有的多镜头视频生成方法一般分为两类. 第一类[54,45]采用两阶段方法:它最初生成每个镜头的起始帧,随后使用图像到视频方法进行扩展. 然而,这种办法产生不尽人意的结果,因为只在初步框架中保证一致性。 第二类[29、43、40、18、3]利用背景学习来模拟镜头之间的关系,确保更好的全球一致性。 这些模型虽然有效,但[29,18,3,43]的可控性有限,因为它们只能通过文本提示来引导生成的内容,使得用户难以实现其准确的预期结果.

blocks.en: 2.3 Controllable Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 可控视频生成

blocks.en:
Precise controllability is essential for user-directed video generation.
Recent methods control camera motion [ 13 , 10 , 9 , 1 , 25 , 5 ] , visual style [ 47 , 24 ] , subject identity [ 19 , 17 ] , object motion in driving scenes [ 22 , 57 , 53 , 7 , 11 , 6 , 23 ] , and human motion [ 14 , 56 , 52 , 4 ] .
CameraCtrl [ 13 ] , CineMaster [ 39 ] , and CamCloneMaster [ 27 ] control camera motion, while VACE [ 19 ] and ConceptMaster [ 17 ] preserve subject identity.
Despite their effectiveness, a major limitation of these approaches is that they are predominantly restricted to single-shot settings.
Driving-oriented methods mainly use layouts or bounding boxes to control object positions and trajectories in structured road scenes, whereas our setting targets 3D subject placement and orientation across cinematic shots.
To address multi-shot controllability, MultiShotMaster [ 40 ] recently proposed the first controllable multi-shot video generation framework.
However, its controllability remains confined to the 2D domain, limiting fine-grained control over subject orientation and spatial positioning critical for cinematic storytelling.
Thus, we propose a fine-grained, 3D-controlled multi-shot video generation model, empowering creators with precise spatial control for complex video production.
blocks.zh:
精确的可控性对于用户引导的视频生成至关重要.
近代方法控制相机运动[13,10,9,1,25,5],视觉风格[47,24],主题身份[19,17],驾驶场景中的物体运动[22,57,53,7,11,6,23],以及人类运动[14,56,52,4].
CameraCtrl [13],CineMaster [39],和CamCloneMaster [27] 控制相机运动,而VACE [19]和ConceptMaster [17] 则保留主题身份.
尽管它们很有效,但这些方法的一个主要限制是它们主要限于单发环境。
驱动导向方法主要使用布局或边框来控制结构化道路场景中的物体位置和轨迹,而我们设定的目标则是3D主题的放置和方向横跨电影镜头.
为了解决多镜头可控性问题,MultiShotMaster[40]最近提出了第一个可控多镜头视频生成框架.
然而,其可控性仍局限于2D领域,限制了对主题定向和空间定位的精细控制,对电影故事讲述至关重要.
因此,我们提出一种精细的,3D控制的多镜头视频生成模型,赋予创作者精确的空间控制能力,用于复杂的视频制作.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
We propose MeV for coherent multi-shot storytelling video generation conditioned on hierarchical text and explicit subject-level layout control.
We first introduce Subject Layout Guidance by encoding each subject with oriented 3D bounding boxes and a NOCS-based representation, projecting them into per-frame 2D layout maps and injecting them into the ControlDiT backbone to precisely control subject placement and facing direction over time (Sec. 3.2.2 ).
We then decompose the caption into global, shot, and subject levels and fuse them with a Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism to improve narrative consistency and subject coherence across shots (Sec. 3.2.3 ).
To support large-scale training, we also build a multi-shot video annotation pipeline that provides hierarchical captions and shot-wise subject layout supervision (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们提议以分级文字和明确的主题级别布局控制为条件,采用连贯的多镜头故事制作方式。
我们首先引入主题布局指导,将每个主题编码为面向3D的边框和一个基于NOCS的表示,将其投射到每帧2D布局图中,并注入ControlDiT主干线,以准确控制主题位置,并随着时间的推移面对方向(第3.2.2条)。
然后,我们把标题分解成全球、拍摄和主题级别,并将其与分级背景关注机制相连接,以提高叙述一致性和不同镜头的主题一致性(第3.2.3节)。
为了支持大规模培训,我们还建造了多镜头视频注释管道,提供分级标题和射向主题布局监督(第3.3节)。

While the 3D layout control explicitly defines the spatial-temporal dynamics of a subject, we must also ensure that the subject’s appearance aligns strictly with its specific textual description, avoiding semantic bleed across different shots or subjects (e.g., a character’s clothing style leaking into the background).
To effectively associate the hierarchical text conditions with their corresponding visual regions, we propose a Hierarchical Context Attention (HCA) mechanism as shown in Fig. 3 ,
where the subject regions are obtained by projecting the corresponding 3D bounding boxes onto the 2D image plane without requiring additional user specification.
Standard cross-attention globally broadcasts all text tokens to all visual tokens, which often leads to attribute confusion in complex multi-shot generation.
To mitigate this, HCA modifies the attention weights by introducing a meticulously designed mask matrix that restricts the receptive field of visual tokens.

为了有效地将分级文本条件与相应的视觉区域联系起来,我们建议采用图3所示的分级背景关注机制。

标准交叉式全球广播所有文字符号给所有视觉符号,这往往导致复杂多镜头生成时的属性混淆.

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Training and Inference Paradigm
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 培训和推论

blocks.en:
MeV is trained in a two-stage manner.
We first train the Hierarchical Context Attention Mask, which strengthens hierarchical context modeling and improves coherence across multi-shot sequences.
We then introduce the Subject Layout injection module and continue training to endow the model with layout-conditioned, subject-level controllability.
This second stage is conducted on our annotated dataset of 160k samples; throughout training, we randomly sample clips with different video lengths and varying numbers of shots to enhance robustness to diverse narrative structures.
blocks.zh:
MeV分两个阶段进行训练.
我们首先训练"分级背景关注面具",它加强分级背景建模,提高多镜头序列的一致性.
然后,我们引入主题布局注射模块,并继续进行培训,使模型具有布局条件的可控性。
这个第二阶段是在我们160k样本的注解数据集上进行的;在整个培训过程中,我们随机抽取了不同视频长度和不同镜头数量的片段,以增强对不同叙事结构的强健性。

blocks.en:
During inference, the proposed framework enables controllable multi-shot video generation, maintaining text-driven inter-shot coherence as well as subject consistency.
With explicit layout inputs, it further allows precise control over each subject’s attributes, including position and orientation.
Moreover, both the number of shots and the duration of each shot are configurable, supporting highly customized multi-shot video storytelling.
blocks.zh:
在推论期间,拟议框架能够产生可控多镜头视频,保持文本驱动的跨镜头一致性以及主题一致性。
有了明确的布局投入,它进一步能够精确控制每个主体的属性,包括位置和方向.
此外,拍摄次数和每次拍摄的持续时间都是可以想象的,支持高度定制的多镜头视频故事讲述.

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-Shot Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 多热数据注释

blocks.en: To support large-scale training, we build a scalable annotation pipeline tailored for multi-shot videos, consisting of three components: multi-shot video collection, 3D layout construction, and hierarchical caption generation (as shown in Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 为了支持大规模培训,我们建造了适合多镜头视频的可伸缩注释管道,由三部分组成:多镜头视频收集,3D布局构建,以及分级字幕生成(如图4所示).

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Multi-shot video Collection.
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 多镜头视频集.

blocks.en:
At the data level, to obtain multi-shot videos at sufficient scale, we collect video clips from the Internet, covering sources such as TV series, movies, and documentaries.
Since our method requires precise control at the shot level, we apply TransNet V2 [ 34 ] to the raw videos for shot boundary detection, producing scene/shot-level segments, based on which we construct multi-shot video samples.
blocks.zh:
在数据层面,为了获得足够规模的多镜头视频,我们从互联网上收集视频剪辑,涵盖电视连续剧,电影,纪录片等来源.
由于我们的方法需要在镜头级别上进行精确控制,我们对镜头边界探测的原始视频应用TransNet V2[34],产生场景/镜头级别片段,在此基础上我们构建多镜头视频样本.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 3D Layout Construction.
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 三维 布局建设.

blocks.en:
To obtain a 3D layout representation analogous to a “shot blocking sheet,” we perform subject-level geometric construction.
Concretely, we first use Detectron2 [ 44 ] to detect subjects in each shot, and then use SAM2 [ 33 ] to track them across frames, obtaining a per-frame mask for each subject.
Next, we apply CameraHMR [ 31 ] for human mesh recovery to obtain SMPL-based 3D human representations [ 26 ] .
To unify 3D geometric relationships across different subjects and camera viewpoints, we further use Pi3 [ 42 ] to reconstruct the entire scene and recover per-frame depth, and align the SMPL meshes with the depth maps, resulting in subject meshes in a unified scale and coordinate system.
Finally, we compute a 3D bounding box that tightly encloses each mesh. Inspired by the NOCS [ 37 , 48 ] , we encode the box in the Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS), which preserves fine-grained geometric information such as orientation. We then project the NOCS-encoded 3D boxes onto the image plane, yielding a 2D layout sequence as the conditioning signal.
blocks.zh:
为了获得类似于“射击挡板”的三维布局,我们进行主题几何构造。
具体来说,我们首先使用Detectron2[44]来探测每个镜头中的试题,然后使用SAM2[33]来跟踪它们跨帧,为每个试题获得每帧的面具.
接下来,我们应用相机HMR[31]进行人体网格恢复,以获得基于SMPL的3D人类表示[26].
为了统一不同主体和相机角度的3D几何关系,我们进一步使用Pi3[42]来重建整个场景并恢复每帧深度,并使SMPL meshes与深度图一致,从而形成一个统一的尺度和坐标系统.
最后,我们计算一个3D的边框 紧紧地绑着每个网格。 在NOCS[37,48]的启发下,我们编码了规范化物体坐标空间(NOCS)中的盒子,它保存了定向等精细的几何信息. 然后,我们将NOCS编码的3D盒投影到图像平面上,生成一个2D布局序列作为调制信号.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Hierarchical Caption Construction.
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 等级说明建筑。

blocks.en:
At the text annotation level, to improve controllability of text conditions and reduce semantic drift during generation, we construct hierarchical captions with three levels: global, shot, and subject.
For each multi-shot video, we first use Gemini 3 Flash to generate a global caption for the entire video, focusing on the overall scene and major events; based on this, we further infer shot-level captions conditioned on the content of each shot.
For subject-level captions, we first provide Gemini with subject crops from each shot obtained via SAM2 [ 33 ] , and ask it to merge the same subject across the whole video and assign a globally unique subject ID.
We then generate a description for each subject conditioned on the global caption, resulting in hierarchical text annotations aligned with the multi-shot structure and suitable for enforcing subject consistency.
blocks.zh:
在文本注释一级,为了提高文本条件的可控性,减少生成时的语义漂移,我们构建了分级标题,分三个级别:全局,镜头和主题.
对于每个多镜头视频,我们首先使用双子座3 Flash来生成整个视频的全球字幕,关注整个场景和重大事件;在此基础上,我们进一步推断以每个镜头内容为条件的镜头级别字幕.
对于主题级别的字幕,我们首先向双子座提供通过SAM2[33]获得的每个镜头中的主题作物,并要求它在整个视频中合并同一主题,并指定一个全球独特的主题ID.
然后,我们生成一个以全局标题为条件的每个主题的描述,从而形成与多镜头结构相一致的、适合执行主题一致性的分级文字说明。

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details.
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况。

blocks.en:
Our model is built upon a 1B-parameter single-shot text-to-video (T2V) backbone and is trained in two stages.
In the first stage, we train the single-shot model with our Hierarchical Captions to enable precise shot-level control and fine-grained subject description.
In the second stage, we extend controllability with 3D layout guidance by training only the ControlDiT branch while keeping the rest of the model frozen.
We annotate 160K multi-shot videos, each comprising 2–6 shots with up to 250 frames.
All experiments are conducted on 32 GPUs with a batch size of 1.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型建立在1B参数的单镜头文本对视频(T2V)主干上,分两个阶段进行训练.
在第一阶段,我们用我们的等级说明来训练单发模型,以便精确的射击级别控制和精细的标的描述.
在第二阶段,我们通过只训练ControlDIT分支,同时保持其余模型的冷冻,通过3D布局指导来扩展可控性.
我们给160K多镜头的视频做注释,每个视频包含2-6镜头,最多250帧。
所有实验都用32个GPU进行,批量尺寸为1.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en:
Following prior work [ 40 , 28 , 29 ] , we use Gemini 2.5 to design 100 samples of multi-shot prompts, and adapt each prompt to match the required input style of each baseline method.
These prompts cover a wide range of topics, enabling a comprehensive assessment of a model’s ability to maintain consistency across diverse scenarios in multi-shot narrative video generation.

blocks.en:
We evaluate performance from multiple aspects:
(1) Text Alignment: following prior work [ 40 , 28 ] , we compute the similarity between text features and per-shot video features extracted by ViCLIP [ 41 ] .
(2) Inter-shot Consistency: we first measure the holistic semantic similarity between ViCLIP shot features; then, on keyframes (first, middle, and last frames), we apply YOLOv11 [ 20 ] and ByteTrack [ 51 ] to detect and crop subjects and backgrounds, and use DINOv2 [ 30 ] feature to quantify subject consistency and scene consistency across shots.
(3) Intra-shot Consistency: within each shot, we similarly use YOLOv11 and ByteTrack to crop subjects and backgrounds from keyframes, and employ DINOv2 feature to evaluate subject consistency and scene consistency within the shot.
(4) Transition Control: following prior work [ 29 ] , we report the shot cut accuracy score to measure shot-cut accuracy.
(5) Overall Quality: following prior work [ 28 , 40 ] , we report Aesthetic Quality and the Narrative Coherence score to assess overall narrative quality.
(6) Orientation Quality: We assess controllability by comparing subject orientations in the generated videos and GT, reporting yaw/pitch/roll errors as well as mAOE and OSYaw.
blocks.zh:
我们从多方面评价业绩:
(1)文本对齐:在前作[40,28]之后,我们计算文本特性与由VICLIP[41]提取的每集视频特性之间的相似性.
(2)射击一致性:我们首先测量VICLIP射击特性之间的整体语义相似性;然后,在键框(第一,中,末帧)上,我们应用YOLOv11 [20]和ByteTrack [51]来探测和作物主题和背景,并使用DINov2 [30]特性来量化主题的一致性和场景各镜头的一致性.
(3)内射一致性:在每个镜头内,我们同样使用YOLOv11和ByteTrack来进行来自键框的作物主题和背景,并使用DINOv2特性来评价镜头内的主题一致性和场景一致性.
(4)过渡控制:经过前期工作[29],我们报告射门切精分,以测量射门准确度.
(5)总体质量:在之前的工作[28,40]之后,我们报告审美质量和叙述一致性分数,以评估总体叙述质量.
(6) 定向质量: 我们通过比较生成的视频和GT中的主题方向来评估可控性,报告yaw/pitch/roll错误以及mAOE和OSYaw.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 量化结果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 reports quantitative comparisons with EchoShot [ 38 ] and MultiShotMaster [ 40 ] on multi-shot video generation.
Overall, our approach achieves the best performance across all metrics, demonstrating improved visual consistency, text alignment, and narrative quality for multi-shot video generation.
For consistency, we outperform prior methods on both intra-shot and inter-shot Subject/Background scores, indicating more stable subjects and backgrounds within each shot and more reliable identity/scene continuity across shot transitions.
This gain mainly comes from the Hierarchical Context Attention Mask Mechanism, which enforces constraints over shots and subjects, and the injected 3D layout, which provides an explicit spatial-structure prior.
Moreover, our method ranks first in Text Alignment and Narrative Coherence, suggesting better adherence to the text prompt and stronger multi-shot storytelling coherence.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 1报告了与EchoShot[38]和MultiShotMaster[40]在多镜头视频生成上的定量比较.
总体而言,我们的方法在所有衡量标准上都取得了最佳业绩,显示出视觉一致性、文字一致性和多镜头视频制作的叙述质量都有所提高。
为了保持一致性,我们在射击内和射击间主体/背景分数方面都比先前的方法要好,表明每个射击内的主题和背景更加稳定,而且射击间过渡中的身份/场景连续性更加可靠。
这一增益主要来自于对镜头和主体实施约束的等级背景关注面具机制,以及注入的3D布局,它提供了一个明确的空间结构前.
此外,我们的方法在文本对齐和叙述一致性中排在首位,这表明要更迅速地遵守文本,并加强多镜头讲故事的一致性。

blocks.en:
Tab. 2 compares the subject-orientation errors of videos generated by different methods.
Our method achieves substantially lower Mean Diff on yaw/pitch/roll and lower mAOE than MultiShotMaster and EchoShot, while obtaining the highest OS Yaw.
These results indicate that the subject orientation in our generated videos is closer to the target pose specified by the storyboard.
This validates our shot-level controllability under layout conditions, enabling users to define the storyboard and layout and then generate fine-grained multi-shot videos matching the intended shot plan.
blocks.zh:
标签2比较了不同方法生成的视频的主题导向错误.
我们的方法在yaw/pitch/roll上实现的平均值Diff和mAOE都比MultiShotMaster和EchoShot低得多,同时获得最高的OS Yaw.
这些结果显示,我们制作的视频中的主题导向更接近故事板指定的目标姿势.
这验证了我们在布局条件下的射击级别可控性,使用户能够定义故事板和布局,然后生成与预定的射击计划相匹配的精致的多镜头视频.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 定性结果

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 5 , we compare our method with EchoShot and MultiShotMaster.
EchoShot struggles to maintain consistent scenes and subjects under cross-view generation, and its outputs do not align well with the corresponding prompts.
MultiShotMaster can preserve subject consistency reasonably well across viewpoints, but it offers limited control over the subject’s motion, making it difficult to precisely satisfy the actions and trajectories required by the storyboard.
In contrast, our method maintains high visual quality while preserving both scene/background and subject consistency across shots, and it enables stronger, fine-grained control over the subject’s motion, making it well-suited for storyboard-driven multi-shot video generation. Fig. 8 shows more multi-shot results while Fig. 6 shows results on how MeV control dynamics with 3D layout.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,我们的方法与EchoShot和MultiShotMaster作比较。
回声 在交叉视图生成下为保持连贯的场景和主题而拼命奋斗,其产出与相应的提示不匹配.
MultiShotMaster可以合理地在各种观点之间保持主题的一致性,但它对主体的运动提供了有限的控制,使得很难准确满足故事板要求的行动和轨迹.
反之,我们的方法保持了高的视觉质量,同时保持了场景/背景和镜头间的主题一致性,它能够对主体的运动进行更有力,精细的控制,使其非常适合故事板驱动的多镜头视频生成. 图8显示更多多镜头结果,而图6则显示3D布局的MeV控制动态的结果.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Ablation Study on Hierarchical Context Attention
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 等级背景研究

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 reports an ablation study on Hierarchical Context Attention to assess its contribution to multi-shot generation. The full model (Base) delivers the best overall trade-off across key metrics.
(1) Notably, removing the mask (w.o. Mask) increases subject and background consistency, but substantially degrades semantic consistency and text alignment, and also weakens transition control and narrative coherence.
This indicates that without the mask constraint, the model tends to collapse multi-shot generation into a near single continuous video, yielding superficially consistent subjects/backgrounds but failing to follow shot-wise semantic changes and textual conditions.
(2) Removing the subject branch (w.o. Sub) makes the model more compliant in text alignment and transition control, yet it significantly harms cross-shot subject consistency and consequently reduces narrative coherence, highlighting the importance of subject-level hierarchical context for preserving identity across shots.
Overall, these results validate that Hierarchical Context Attention improves cross-shot coherence, text adherence, and controllable transitions, leading to more coherent multi-shot narratives.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 4报告了一项关于分级背景关注的研究,以评估其对多镜头生成的贡献。 完整的模型(Base)能够实现关键指标之间最佳的总体权衡。
(1)值得注意的是,摘下面具(w.o.mask)会增加主题和背景的一致性,但会大大降低语义一致性和文本的对齐,同时也会削弱过渡控制和叙事一致性.
这表明,没有面具的制约,模型往往会崩溃多镜头生成一个近乎单一的连续视频,产生表面一致的主题/背景,但未能遵循镜头的语义变化和文字条件.
(2)删除主题分支(w.o. Sub)使得该模型在文本对齐和过渡控制上更加符合要求,然而它却严重损害了交叉拍摄主题的一致性,从而降低了叙事一致性,凸显了主题层次背景对于在镜头中保持身份的重要性.
总体而言,这些结果证实,分层背景关注改进了跨镜头的连贯性,文本的坚持性,以及可控制的过渡,导致更加连贯的多镜头叙述.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Ablation Study on 3D Layout Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 关于三维布局指导的读取研究

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports the ablation study to assess the impact of 3D layout guidance.
The results show that incorporating 3D layout constraints substantially reduces the overall orientation error (Mean Diff and mAOE) and notably improves yaw alignment (OS Yaw), indicating that the generated camera/subject orientations reliably follow the intended 3D shot plan.
This improvement better matches a practical filmmaking workflow, where a director specifies storyboarded shots and camera blocking, and the system “executes” the plan like a cinematographer.
Importantly, the gain on yaw is particularly significant: in typical cinematography, yaw (horizontal heading) largely determines key narrative cues such as facing direction, eyeline relationships, and screen-space spatial continuity, whereas pitch often varies less and is generally less decisive for shot-to-shot staging.
Overall, this validates that 3D layout guidance enhances controllability and predictability of shot orientation, enabling high-fidelity storyboard-driven generation.
blocks.zh:
表3汇报了评估3D布局指导影响的开发研究。
结果显示,纳入3D布局限制可大幅降低总方向误差(Mean Diff和mAOE),并显著改善yaw对齐(OS Yaw),表明生成的相机/主体方向可靠地遵循了预定的3D射击计划.
这种改进更符合实际的电影制作工作流程,即导演具体规定了故事板镜头和相机屏蔽,系统像电影摄影师一样“执行”计划。
重要的是,对yaw的收获是特别重要的:在典型的电影片中,yaw(横向标题)在很大程度上决定了诸如面对方向、眼线关系和屏幕空间连续性等关键叙事提示,而投球往往变化较小,对中弹射击一般没有那么决定性。
总体而言,这验证了3D布局指导能增强射向的可控性和可预测性,使得高真实度的故事板能够驱动生成.

blocks.en: 4.4 Application: Versatile Creative Control
blocks.zh: 4.4 应用: Versatile 创意控制

blocks.en: To demonstrate the versatile controllability, we further show the generation results in Fig. 7 , where MeV enables creators to generate diverse visual outcomes from a unified 3D layout by varying the textual descriptions. At the same time, our method can also vary spatial configurations with the same identity descriptions. This decoupling of 3D spatial layout and semantic descriptions empowers creators with steerability in multi-shot video production.
blocks.zh: 为了展示多功能可控性,我们进一步在图7中显示生成结果,在图7中,MeV通过修改文字描述,使创作者能够从统一的3D布局中产生多样的视觉结果. 同时,我们的方法也可以用相同的身份描述来改变空间配置. 3D空间布局和语义描述的这种脱钩使创作者在多镜头视频制作中具有可引导性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose MeV, a controllable multi-shot video generation framework with both cross-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability.
The key idea is to adopt a 3D-aware layout guidance and a hierarchical context attention mechanism to enable the 3D staging in the multi-shot video generation.
We further develop an automatic data curation and annotation pipeline and construct a 160K multi-shot dataset for training.
We hope this work will inspire future research on production-oriented, 3D-aware controllable multi-shot video generation.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出MeV,是一种可控的多镜头视频生成框架,既具有跨镜头一致性,又具有精细的可控性.
关键理念是采用3D-意识布局引导和分级上下文关注机制,使3D在多镜头视频生成中进行中继.
我们进一步开发自动数据校准和注释管道,并建造160K多发数据集供培训使用。
我们希望这项工作能激发未来对生产导向,3D-意识可控多镜头视频生成的研究.

blocks.en:
While MeV demonstrates strong controllability and consistency, its overall generation quality is still limited by the capacity of the pretrained backbone.
With a relatively constrained parameter scale, the model may struggle to generate high-quality dynamic videos.
In future work, we plan to scale up the model capacity by adopting larger backbones and/or increasing the parameter budget of the controllable modules.
blocks.zh:
虽然MeV表现出强大的可控性和一致性,但其整体生成质量仍受到预先训练的骨干能力的限制.
由于参数尺度相对有限,该模型可能难以生成高质量的动态视频.
在今后的工作中,我们计划通过采用更大的骨干和(或)增加可控制模块的参数预算来扩大模型能力。
